requirement: Bicycles shall not have exposed sharp edges that could cause laceration injuries during normal use or maintenance. All edges that a user may contact shall be smoothed, rolled, or otherwise treated to eliminate sharpness.
requirement_summary: No exposed sharp edges on any user-contactable parts

evidence_required.description: Sharp edge test report per 16 CFR 1500.49 showing no accessible sharp edges
Product photos showing all edges are smoothed or rolled

remediation: Smooth, roll, or otherwise treat all exposed edges to eliminate sharpness per §1512.4(a).

requirement: Bicycles shall not have protruding parts that could cause impalement or snagging injuries. Handlebar ends shall be capped or covered with devices secure against ≥66.8N (15 lbf) removal force. Control cable ends shall be capped or treated to prevent fraying per §1512.4(i). Control cables shall be routed to avoid abrasion per §1512.4(j).
requirement_summary: No protrusions; handlebar caps ≥66.8N; cable ends capped; cables no abrasion

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain handlebar grips or end caps that cover handlebar ends
Product photo showing handlebar ends properly capped and cables properly routed

remediation: Install handlebar end caps or grips covering all handlebar ends, and ensure cables are properly routed per §1512.4(b).
